sections.text:
-Target: all enemies. Ability Power 560. Success value 100. 5x magic damage (Water).
Ability Power boosted by 10 for each increase in Skill level.
-Target: all enemies. Removes buffs.
-Target: all allies. Removes debuffs and special debuffs.
-Target: all allies. Applies 50% elevation for 120 seconds.
-Target: all allies. Applies 30% concentration for 120 seconds.
-Target: yourself. Applies Redoubt for 150 seconds (When in effect, damage to HP and CP will not be taken; [Special] reduces physical/magic damage by 50%; nullifies fixed damage; nullifies special status ailments; nullifies status ailments. Removed after receiving a set amount of damage (300% of max HP excluding buff and field effects)).
-Applies Infinite Element (increases all stats by 120%, restores 5% of damage dealt as HP, and increases HP recovery effects by 50%) to the allied Field for 120 seconds.
Increases stats selected in stat slot 1 by 60000
Increases stats selected in stat slot 2 by 60000
[Unison Effect Boost] Increases the Ability Power of the 560-Ability-Power attack that deals magic water damage 5 times to all enemies at success of 100 points by 500.

[Additional Unison Effect] Target: all allies. Applies Grace for 120 seconds (increases max HP by 100%; nullifies Cost reduction, status ailments, and debuffs. After the effect ends, 100 Cost is restored to your character).

[Additional Unison Effect] Target: all enemies. Activates Time Slice which reduces the time advantageous effects (buffs, special buffs, and non-removable buffs) are applied to the target by 80 seconds.
Only [Velvet Room Residents] Justine & Caroline can be used as Unlocking Potential material
